answer: Sybil resistance can move off the identity layer onto the grading layer. Each reviewer who scores a submission posts a bond, and a random jury may later replay it; if it overturns the score, the bond goes to whoever challenged it. A farm of minted accounts gains nothing from volume: every answer still needs a bonded reviewer, so one honest appeal turns that reviewer from asset into liability. The inlet for new identities stays open, yet approval costs more per fake account. Corrupting Raven costs more than a cluster of clones returns, so they drop the cluster and the saffron flag it earned.
